event: Ventura County Fusion defeated Ballard FC 2-1 in the Western Conference Final to advance to the USL League Two National Semifinals.
Ballard FC eliminated from the 2026 USL League Two playoffs with a 1-2 loss to Ventura County Fusion in the Western Conference Final.
Flint City Bucks defeated Steel City FC 2-1 to win the Central Conference title and advance to the USL League Two National Semifinals.
Vermont Green FC played Asheville City SC in the Eastern Conference Final; result unconfirmed at time of publication.
Laredo Heat SC played Fort Lauderdale United FC in the Southern Conference Final; result unconfirmed at time of publication.
Asheville City SC played Vermont Green FC in the Eastern Conference Final; result unconfirmed at time of publication.
Fort Lauderdale United FC played Laredo Heat SC in the Southern Conference Final; result unconfirmed at time of publication.
Ballard FC won the USL League Two Northwest Division title for the fourth consecutive season, posting a 12-1-1 regular season record.
Central Kansas United defeated Arkansas Wolves 2 3-2 in the UPSL National Playoffs Round of 32, playing the full second half down a man after a red card.
Central Kansas United playing in the UPSL National Quarterfinals on July 25-26; result unconfirmed at time of publication.
Fort Wayne FC hold the longest active unbeaten run in USL League One at 7 games (from April 11 onward, as of late May data).
Corpus Christi FC remain winless through 10 matches played in the 2026 USL League One season.
New York Cosmos on a 4-game losing run and sit last in USL League One with 7 points from 10 matches, despite having the season's top scorer in Ajmeer Spengler (6 goals).
Charlotte Independence on a 4-game winning run in USL League One as of late May 2026.
Athletic Club Boise leads USL League One in total attendance with 43,248 through six home matches (average 7,208 per match), highest-attended fixture drawing 7,227.
Sacramento Republic FC topped their 2026 USL Cup group stage with a 2-0-0 record and +5 goal difference.
USL Championship season operating without a new CBA; players have authorized strike action, and the league agreed to 12-month standard contracts as part of ongoing negotiations.
